title: Benzotriazolium picrate (BTPC): B3LYP/6-311++G(d,p) data on the N4–H4N···O1 ion pair in the gas phase and in IEF-PCM water (geometries, Hessians, wavefunctions, wavefunction analyses and scripts)
description:
Data and scripts for a density functional study of the benzotriazolium picrate ion pair (BTPC; CCDC 835950). The ion pair held together by the charge-assisted N4–H4N···O1 hydrogen bond was rebuilt by symmetry from the crystal structure and optimised at B3LYP/6-311++G(d,p) with PySCF 2.14.0 and geomeTRIC 1.1.1, once in the gas phase and once in an IEF-PCM continuum for water.

Contents: the specification and builder of the ion pair; one settings file per calculation; starting, optimised and trajectory geometries; finite-difference Hessians and harmonic analyses; PySCF checkpoint and Molden wavefunctions; frontier-orbital, molecular electrostatic potential, NCI, ELF and LOL outputs from Multiwfn 2026.9.13 with their grids (xz-compressed); run logs; the register of every number in the associated paper (facts.json) with the scripts that rebuild it; the tables and figures of the paper; and the pinned software environments. The crystal structure itself (Dhanabal et al., Optik 2013) is not redistributed; obtain it from the CCDC.
